jobs.description:
As part of the reinforcement of the Facility team of one of our clients operating in the medical device industry, VIQI is looking for a Technical CAD Draftsperson for a 6-month assignment in the Leuven area, with the possibility of extension.

You will join a technical and industrial environment where your main objective will be to create, update and maintain accurate as-built drawings of buildings and their technical installations.

 

Your responsibilities

• Create and update 2D technical drawings using AutoCAD
• Perform on-site surveys and translate existing installations into accurate as-built drawings
• Work across various building systems, including HVAC, electrical installations, utilities, sanitary systems and data/communication networks
• Ensure the quality and consistency of drawings, including scales, layers, symbols, references and revision status
• Consolidate existing drawings and integrate information from projects, suppliers and contractors
• Maintain a clear and structured approach to CAD documentation, file management and revisions
• Collaborate closely with Facility, Maintenance, Engineering and IT teams, as well as external engineering partners and contractors 
Your profile

• Technical background in Construction, Electromechanics, HVAC, Electricity, Technical Drafting, or equivalent through relevant experience
• Previous experience in technical drafting/CAD within a building, facility, engineering or industrial environment
• Strong command of 2D AutoCAD
• Good understanding of building systems and utilities, such as HVAC and electrical installations
• Comfortable carrying out field surveys and translating technical information into accurate drawings
• Familiar with drawing standards, revision management and document control
• Knowledge of Revit is considered an asset
• You are autonomous, structured and detail-oriented, with good communication skills
• Dutch & English required 
Practical information

• Start date: ASAP
• Duration: 6 months, with possibility of extension
• Mainly on-site, with very limited remote work

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Analyse technical requirements and define solutions for new installations.
• Prepare and draft technical specifications.
• Determine location and configuration of new technical installations.
• Request, analyse and compare supplier and subcontractor proposals.
• Coordinate projects and monitor on-site execution.
• Follow up orders, planning, deadlines and project budgets.
• Coordinate and supervise technical subcontractors.
• Ensure compliance with technical specifications, safety and regulations.
• Ensure environmental and noise-related compliance.
• Collaborate with network operators, inspection bodies, engineering offices, public authorities and suppliers.
• Produce clear technical reports, specifications and project documentation.
• Maintain effective communication with internal customers and stakeholders. 
TOP SKILLS (MUST HAVE) 
¿ Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Industrial Electricity, or equivalent.  
¿ Strong knowledge of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical installations.  
¿ Good understanding of AC and DC electrical systems.  
¿ Knowledge of RGIE / AREI electrical regulations.  
¿ Technical knowledge of:  
o High-voltage cabins.  
o Main and distribution switchboards.  
o UPS systems.  
o Rectifiers.  
o Batteries.  
¿ Knowledge of HVAC, including cooling, ventilation and heating requirements.  
¿ Experience or demonstrated capabilities in technical project management.  
¿ Experience coordinating and supervising technical subcontractors.  
¿ Strong focus on safety, quality, deadlines and budget management.  
¿ Driving licence B and willingness to travel frequently between technical sites.  
¿ French mandatory with comprehension of Dutch.  

BONUS SKILLS (NICE TO HAVE) 
¿ Knowledge of lifts/elevators.  
¿ Knowledge of fire detection systems.  
¿ English.  
¿ Experience working with engineering offices, inspection bodies, network operators or 
public authorities.  
¿ Strong command of MS Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote and 
SharePoint.

Are you a financial expert and does accounting have no secrets for you? Do you like studying figures and do you like to have ownership? Then the position of Accounting Specialist at Miele Belux is your next career step! In this position, you are the pivot between the financial processes, the people and the resulting administration. Together with the controllers, shared service centre and external parties, such as our accountants and advisors, you ensure accurate accounting. This not only involves the correct administration of the figures, but also identifying bottlenecks and risks in terms of legislation and regulations. You will be working in a multinational team, with a manager who focuses on your talents and prepares you for a great career within Miele. The many international contacts within the Miele group offer you the opportunity to build an interesting network.
 

What you will be doing:
 

The Accounting Specialist plays a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization by ensuring accurate financial record-keeping, timely processing of transactions, and compliance with group financial policies and local regulatory requirements. The role supports effective financial management through attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to excellence. You are the first point of contact within the Belgium affiliate and the right hand of the Accounting Manager covering the cluster of Belgium/Luxembourg/Netherlands/France.
 

Key Responsibilities:
 
 

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities for the Belgian entity in collaboration with our global shared services (MGS) teams in Poland. 

• Ensure accurate bookings, accruals, reconciliations, and allocations to cost and profit centers. 

• Be a key point of contact for external and internal audit matters. 

• Support tax and legal compliance processes, including VAT, and other statutory declarations. 

• Evaluate internal systems, controls, and risks, and provide recommendations for improvement. 

• Contribute to Belgian and global process optimization projects. 

• Support the FP&A team with financial transparency, reporting, and follow-up.  

 

The Accounting Specialist we are looking for:
 

We are looking for someone who is structured, accountable, and principled, with a strong sense of ownership for financial integrity and operational follow-through. You enjoy working with both numbers and practical coordination, and you are comfortable communicating with internal stakeholders as well as external service partners.
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting, economics, business administration. 

• +8 years of experience in a similar role. 

• A strong accounting foundation, with proven experience in closing periods, balance sheet ownership, statutory and tax reporting. 

• Handles sensitive financial information with the highest level of confidentiality, integrity, and accountability while adhering to professional and organizational standards. 

• Communicates financial information clearly and professionally to colleagues, management, auditors, and other stakeholders. 

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach with a passion for continuous improvement and eagerness to take ownership, contribute to harmonization of processes across the region. 

• Works collaboratively across departments and builds positive relationships. 

• Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. 

• Experience in a multinational, multi-location matrix environment.. 

• Experience working with SAP is an advantage, proficiency in Excel. 

• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch/French, both written and verbal.

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.
